2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Memories of Valor

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Memories of Valor

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Memories of Valor

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Memories of Valor

c6e293f3.text:
They came at us from everywhere, clawing from hidden holes at our feet and dropping upon us from silent perches above.  Half our men fell in those first panicked minutes.  The rest, including myself, tried to flee.  As I ran I saw so many of my brothers taken by tooth and claw, heard so many screams cut short or gurgle to silence.

For all I know, I am the only $r to escape that place.
c6e293f3.title: Jitters' Completed Journal

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Memories of Valor

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Memories of Valor

11068|bf2f71d7.name: Betty Quin
11068|bf2f71d7.text: Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?

11068|fe5ba491.name: Betty Quin
11068|fe5ba491.text: Hmm... well you seem capable enough. If you truly desire to learn, then nothing will stand in your way! I will guide you through your first steps on what I hope will be a long and fulfilling path.

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1300|3142c9a2.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|3142c9a2.text: Very well, let your journey of tailoring begin.

1300|d1216699.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|d1216699.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

1312|0624ab70.name: Ardwyn Cailen
1312|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1317|fcbd9346.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|fcbd9346.text: You are not ready. Speak to Betty Quinn, she's standing by the stairs over there. Return to me when you have achieved a higher enlightenment.

1318|0624ab70.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1350|213bb5c1.name: Theresa Moulaine
1350|213bb5c1.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journeys. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

14722|00e95851.name: Clavicus Knavingham
14722|00e95851.text:
Friend - Stormwind needs your assistance and your generosity!

Our once large stockpile of textiles has run critically low.  Stormwind is now engaged in a multi-pronged effort to rebuild those stocks for the manufacture of textiles and bandages!  Your donation of cloth would help Stormwind immensely, as well as earn the respect of the citizenry!

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

197|877c25a9.name: Marshal McBride
197|877c25a9.text: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...

2123|39920e92.name: Dark Cleric Duesten
2123|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3136|e91b638d.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|e91b638d.text: Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.

3143|e14f5e15.name: Gornek
3143|e14f5e15.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3155|0402cd55.name: Rwag
3155|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3170|0402cd55.name: Kaplak
3170|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3296|472ac411.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|472ac411.text: Looking for Shenthul of the Shadowswift Brotherhood, huh?  In The Drag across from Droffers and Son Salvage look for a tunnel leading down into the Cleft of Shadow.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus

3328|0402cd55.name: Ormok
3328|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

376|bab8ec77.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

377|bab8ec77.name: Priestess Josetta
377|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

459|710d6c2c.name: Drusilla La Salle
459|710d6c2c.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Even if you do not follow the path of the $c, you would do well to remember that.

483|ed056522.name: Elaine Trias
483|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5489|8fca8484.name: Brother Joshua
5489|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5489|bab8ec77.name: Brother Joshua
5489|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

5811|6fac1a00.name: Kamari
5811|6fac1a00.text: You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

5811|aea93ec3.name: Kamari
5811|aea93ec3.text: Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk

5953|5e4e18c6.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|5e4e18c6.text: You'll need to head to Orgrimmar for that.  Just follow the road heading out of Razor Hill to the north through the canyon and you'll come to it.  When you get there ask one of their grunts for further directions.

6373|721fd095.name: Dane Winslow
6373|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6374|4bd37020.name: Cylina Darkheart
6374|4bd37020.text: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|4fc5af49.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4fc5af49.text: Ah, you're looking for Lucan Cordell.  He runs a shop on the outside of the Magic Quarter on your way to the Stockade.

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7953|de02093f.name: Xar'Ti
7953|de02093f.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

906|874945f8.name: Maximillian Crowe
906|874945f8.text: The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

1598-progress.name: Drusilla La Salle

1598-progress.title: The Stolen Tome

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?

262-progress.name: Madame Eva
262-progress.text: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it.  I may be able to divine something of its owner.
262-progress.title: The Shadowy Figure

265-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
265-progress.text:
Sometimes I'll sell blank books to scholars and mages, or to anyone who wants to keep a journal.

I remember well everyone to whom I sold a book within the last few months...
265-progress.title: The Shadowy Search Continues

266-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
266-progress.text:
The Scarlet Raven doesn't see the business it used to, but we still do get travelers passing through.

If you can describe the person you're looking for, maybe I'll remember him.
266-progress.title: Inquire at the Inn

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

3083-progress.name: Rwag
3083-progress.text:
Welcome to the Valley of Trials, $N. You wouldn't be here if you hadn't gotten my tablet, so I will get to the point.

I am Rwag and I am responsible for training the rogues, thieves, and cutpurses here in the Valley. I'm the one the Hand will turn to if you're not ready for what's to come. But don't worry, the Hand won't be controlling everything you do, but it would be wise to work with them if they have need of your talents.
3083-progress.title: Encrypted Tablet

3097-progress.name: Dark Cleric Duesten
3097-progress.text:
Ah, so between fire, plague, rioting, and much worse, one more of the "faithful" comes to my door. Well, let me bid you welcome, $c. And allow me a moment to explain a thing or two before you decide it's time for you to seek whatever drives you forward: the Holy Light no longer concerns you, the spirits of your forefathers are fairy tales, and creatures from the Nether don't want you.

Do you understand me so far?
3097-progress.title: Hallowed Scroll

3101-progress.name: Brother Sammuel
3101-progress.text: Finally! We meet face to face, brother to brother. I welcome you to Northshire. This will be your home for a short time while you learn the ins and outs of how things are done, but know that Stormwind is not far off, and sooner or later, your path will take you there. But until then, be patient... Knight of the Silver Hand.
3101-progress.title: Consecrated Letter

3105-progress.name: Drusilla La Salle
3105-progress.text: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, $N. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... pathetic mundanes.
3105-progress.title: Tainted Letter

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

333-progress.name: Rema Schneider
333-progress.text: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
333-progress.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

334-progress.name: Thurman Schneider
334-progress.text: Are you here to buy clothes?
334-progress.title: Package for Thurman

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

377-progress.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-progress.text: So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed.  Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward.  We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in Stormwind.
377-progress.title: Crime and Punishment

386-progress.name: Guard Berton
386-progress.text: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade?  I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom.  He was sentenced to die, $N, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
386-progress.title: What Comes Around...

3902-complete.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-complete.text: Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless.  Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
3902-complete.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

391-progress.name: Warden Thelwater
391-progress.text: Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, $N?
391-progress.title: The Stockade Riots

393-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
393-progress.text: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, $c?
393-progress.title: Shadow of the Past

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable $c, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

7791-complete.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-complete.text: Wonderful!  We thank you for your generous donation, $N!
7791-complete.title: A Donation of Wool

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

80-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
80-progress.text: Back again, $N?  What do you have this time?
80-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call
